issues.desc: background.md Solution Tradeoffs / checklist items (CHK-002/003/004) repeatedly use the TDD term "RED" ("RED fixture", "RED first", "RED: the fixture must initially report...") without ever expanding or glossing it on first appearance; a fresh reader with no internalized project jargon cannot confirm this means the red-green-refactor convention (write a failing test before the fix) purely from the surrounding text.

background.md Trigger Event section reads: state the contract 'both sides of a rename remain seeds' -- 'seeds' appears to be a typo (likely intended 'seen'/'visible'); grep across packages/main/src for the phrase 'both sides of a rename' and 'remain seed' finds no matching source comment, so this looks like a garbled quote rather than a verified literal contract string, and could confuse a standalone reader.

CHK-004 explicitly defers migrating flagged callers to a follow-up story. This is honest scoping (the background explains three prior hand-enumerations were wrong), but the future understanding.outcome should state what an operator can observe from the audit fixture itself -- e.g. the fixture prints a classified list, the operator can read it, and it gates the follow-up scope mechanically rather than by hand-enumeration.
